30: MUTED = (148, 163, 184)  # #94a3b8
31: ACCENT = (64, 156, 255)  # #409cff
32: BADGE_FG = (203, 213, 225)  # #cbd5e1
33: BADGE_BG = (30, 41, 59)  # #1e293b
34: HAIRLINE = (51, 65, 85)  # #334155

53: def _wrap(
54:     draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw,
55:     text: str,
56:     font: ImageFont.ImageFont | ImageFont.FreeTypeFont,
57:     max_width: float,
58: ) -> list[str]:
59:     """Greedy word wrap measured with draw.textlength."""
60:     lines: list[str] = []
61:     current = ""
62:     for word in text.split():
63:         candidate = word if not current else f"{current} {word}"
64:         if draw.textlength(candidate, font=font) <= max_width:
65:             current = candidate
66:         elif current:
67:             lines.append(current)
68:             current = word
69:         else:
70:             current = word
71:     if current:
72:         lines.append(current)

76: def _draw_mark(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, box: tuple[int, int, int, int], line_width: int) -> None:
77:     x0, y0, x1, y1 = box
78:     width = x1 - x0 + 1
79:     height = y1 - y0 + 1
80:     draw.rounded_rectangle(box, radius=max(2, width // 4), fill=SURFACE, outline=HAIRLINE, width=1)
81:     points = [(x0 + px * (width - 1), y0 + py * (height - 1)) for px, py in _MARK_POINTS]
82:     draw.line(points, fill=ACCENT, width=line_width, joint="curve")
83:     apex_x, apex_y = points[-1]
84:     radius = max(2, round(width * 0.09))
85:     draw.ellipse(
86:         (apex_x - radius, apex_y - radius, apex_x + radius, apex_y + radius),
87:         fill=ACCENT,
88:     )

91: def _draw_pill(draw: ImageDraw.ImageDraw, label: str, right: int, cy: int) -> None:
92:     font = ImageFont.load_default(size=22)
93:     pad_x = 20
94:     height = 44
95:     width = round(draw.textlength(label, font=font)) + 2 * pad_x
96:     x1, y0 = right, cy - height // 2
97:     x0, y1 = x1 - width, y0 + height
98:     draw.rounded_rectangle((x0, y0, x1, y1), radius=height // 2, fill=BADGE_BG)
99:     draw.text(((x0 + x1) / 2, cy), label, font=font, fill=BADGE_FG, anchor="mm")

103:     buffer = io.BytesIO()
104:     image.save(buffer, format="PNG", compress_level=9, optimize=True)

122:     middle_y = MARGIN + mark_size // 2

125:         WORDMARK,
126:         font=ImageFont.load_default(size=30),
127:         fill=TEXT,
128:         anchor="lm",
129:     )
130:     _draw_pill(draw, PILL_LABEL, right=width - MARGIN, cy=middle_y)
131: 
132:     text_width = width - 2 * MARGIN
133:     size = HEADLINE_SIZES[0]
134:     font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
135:     headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
136:     for size in HEADLINE_SIZES[1:]:
137:         if len(headline_lines) <= 2:
138:             break
139:         font = ImageFont.load_default(size=size)
140:         headline_lines = _wrap(draw, headline, font, text_width)
141: 
142:     y = 200
143:     for line in headline_lines[:2]:
144:         draw.text((MARGIN, y), line, font=font, fill=TEXT)
145:         y += round(size * 1.25)

147:     subhead_font = ImageFont.load_default(size=28)

153:     draw.text(
154:         (MARGIN, height - MARGIN),
155:         url,
156:         font=ImageFont.load_default(size=26),

# Deployment

## Project Site (GitHub Pages)

The static site in `website/` is published to
**[https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/](https://alehar9320.github.io/agentic-odi/)**
by [`.github/workflows/pages.yml`](../.github/workflows/pages.yml).

- A push to `main` runs the website tests, builds `_site` from `website/`, and
  deploys the artifact with `actions/deploy-pages`.
- `workflow_dispatch` republishes the site from the Actions tab without a code
  change.
- Pages is configured with the "GitHub Actions" source, so there is no
  `gh-pages` branch. Removing `pages.yml` stops all publishing and the site
  returns 404.
- The `github-pages` environment only allows deployments from `main`.

## Hosted MCP Server

The server is deployed via **[Horizon Prefect](https://www.prefect.io/horizon)**,
Prefect's managed infrastructure for hosting MCP-compatible agents.

## Test Chat (UI)

Interact with the deployed agent directly in your browser:

> **[https://horizon.prefect.io/alhase/servers/agentic-odi/chat](https://horizon.prefect.io/alhase/servers/agentic-odi/chat)**

## MCP Server Endpoint

Integrate via the MCP protocol at:

> **[https://agentic-odi.fastmcp.app/mcp](https://agentic-odi.fastmcp.app/mcp)**

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Authentication is required** to access the MCP server endpoint. Please reach
> out to the maintainers to obtain the necessary credentials before connecting a
> client.

## Hosted Studio

The Living Studio SPA is deployed to Cloudflare Workers:

| Environment | URL |
|---|---|
| Production (`main`) | **[https://agentic-odi.alehar.workers.dev/](https://agentic-odi.alehar.workers.dev/)** |
| Pull request preview | Posted automatically by Cloudflare Workers Builds as a PR comment |

Production deploys on every push to `main`. The Worker is `agentic-odi`; keep
`name` in `wrangler.jsonc` aligned with the Worker connected in the dashboard.
Preview builds run for non-production branches and are ephemeral: the Cloudflare
PR comment is the source of truth, so do not copy a preview URL into docs. The
hosted UI loads without a backend; canvas data, chat, and mutations need the
sidecar tunnel described below.

## Living Studio on a Free Cloudflare Worker

Workers Containers — the only way to run the Python sidecar entirely on
Cloudflare — requires the Workers Paid plan. On the free plan, the Worker serves
the built SPA as Workers Static Assets and proxies `/api/*` to the sidecar
